title: thelypteris pozoi subsp. mollissima
intro: Thelypteris pozoi subsp. mollissima, commonly known as the soft-leaved maidenhair fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris pozoi subsp. mollissima include anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects, making it a potential treatment for wounds and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects.
